name: x4y6mc-answer-watchdog
goal: Retire answers to ended runs without alerts and send each stale-live alert batch once while preserving delivery to live runs.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An open item can have a newly answered question and only an ended run; no live delivery or CoS alert is needed. A replay with new queue IDs must represent the same logical notification.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The finished-session case stopped after proving no retry. Extend it past a later answer and grace period. The CoS replay case used only explicit dependency messages; extend it with answer generations and refreshed queue IDs.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed red 869e5554e0 reproduces the old-run alert, duplicate batch and premature write to a blocked pane before dispatch reactivates it.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Validate the current run before answer delivery or CoS notification; preserve the answer through a later launch or scheduler reactivation, and key CoS receipts by generation.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
Review adjacent watchdog delivery and alert routes for the same lifecycle and duplicate receipt gaps.
